note: Original generated artwork and logo studies. The approved logo is traced as vector paths for UI use. Generated board typography is a concept; the UI uses the actual DM Sans font.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and style anchor.
Create a new expression of this screenprint as artwork for the software brand Aboiteau. Landscape 3:2, one artwork edge to edge.
Keep the original's tactile screenprinted ink, warm uncoated paper, bold visual movement, large blue/red masses and lively cropped marks. Change the composition enough to be an homage rather than a replica: fewer small marks, broader calm paper passages, irregular off-axis ink fields, more deliberate spaciousness.
Completely remove the yellow star, with no silhouette, points, star-shaped gap or trace remaining. Introduce yellow instead as one broad unapologetic rectangular/irregular ink SWATCH crossing between paper and blue, about 10–15% of the surface. Its ends should be blunt/soft-edged, never pointed. Yellow is a compositional colour, not a cultural emblem.
Use ultramarine approx #1746D1, warmer softer vermilion #F04B32, paper #F6EEDD, yellow #F7D447, optional tiny pink #ED5798 ink overprint. Break up any arrangement that could look like a flag. The blue and red masses should differ in size, orientation and position. Make this feel like contemporary art from a confident software brand: movement held inside a clear structure.
Absolutely no stars, flags, literal waves, maps, boats, letterforms, logos, borders, captions, mockups or cultural symbols. No gradients. No faux distressed ornamental clutter. One compelling, spacious, original screenprint composition.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Keep this exact blue A logo, its overall outer silhouette, location, proportions, sloped legs, rounded apex and feet, solid ultramarine colour and plain ivory background.
Make ONLY this optical refinement:
WIDEN THE DIAGONAL NEGATIVE-SPACE SLASH substantially, about twice its current perpendicular width, until it joins the upper triangular inner counter naturally and cleanly. Expand the slash mostly upward into the little blue projecting point. Completely eliminate the thin blue spike / wedge visible along the bottom-left edge of the upper triangular counter. The inner triangular opening and the wide diagonal cut must read as ONE continuous generously open negative shape, without a snag, cusp, leftover triangle, taper or lightning-bolt corner.
The slash itself remains perfectly straight with parallel edges, rising left to right at the same angle and running completely through both outer edges of the A. No bends or hook. Keep enough blue mass in both separate pieces for the emblem to feel sturdy, not fragmented. Smooth and optically balance only the junction where counter and slash meet; preserve the rest.
One clean standalone mark only, on the same flat warm ivory background. No text, no border, no additional version, no shadows, no glow, no gradient, no texture, no new graphic elements. Flat uniform 2D ink.

Use case: logo-brand.
Create a cohesive finished FIRST-PASS BRAND IDENTITY BOARD for Aboiteau, landscape 3:2, using the established art language and the newly approved symbol.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED LOGO SYMBOL, highest priority: a broad rounded capital A split by a generous full rising diagonal cut, connected naturally to its triangular inner counter. Preserve that exact shape, proportions and cut. Do not redesign, bend the channel, join the pieces or replace it with any other A.
Input image 2 supplies the APPROVED OVERALL FEEL and lowercase sans-serif WORDMARK STYLE ONLY. Its old two-bar symbol is retired; do not use that old symbol. Use its sturdy clean lowercase "aboiteau" lettering with confident spacing.
Input image 3 is the APPROVED ART LANGUAGE: blue/red screenprinted movement, sunny yellow as a broad swatch and small pink overprint on warm uncoated paper. No star or cultural emblem.
Brand product: coding-agent infrastructure with chosen repo, model and permissions, Slack/HTTP access and workspace checkpoints. Clear, warm, assured, expressive.
Board layout: generous editorial organisation, not a dense template. Large primary lockup across the top: approved A mark in ultramarine, "aboiteau" in solid near-black. Headline sample beneath: exact text "Coding agents. On your terms." A substantial but carefully cropped expressive screenprint field through the middle/right. Lower area shows one smaller all-blue lockup, one reversed ivory-on-blue lockup, and large labelled rectangular colour swatches.
Typography: sturdy clean human grotesk, like the original reference board, not the soft serif wordmark exploration. No named font claims or invented font names.
Palette design targets: ultramarine #1746D1, vermilion #F04B32, yellow #F7D447, paper #F6EEDD, ink #212722; pink #ED5798 used only as a small overprint accent, optional. Colours within generated art are approximate; no hex labels. Swatch names exactly "Ultramarine", "Vermilion", "Yellow", "Paper", "Ink".
Exact text: "aboiteau", "Coding agents. On your terms.", and the five swatch names only. No page title, version stamp, lorem ipsum, process explanation or long manifesto.
The precise clean logo and quiet reading space should balance the rough energetic print. Keep all wording accurate and the approved A recognisable at every size.
Absolutely no stars, flags, maps, literal maritime imagery, generic AI motifs, gradients, glow, bevels, shadows on logos or made-up partner badges. This is one coherent identity with one approved symbol, not a logo options grid.
